campaign_logline: A desperate pilot navigates the tense trade routes between three competing corporate empires.
campaign_pitch: Scavenge resources from derelicts. Navigate political tensions between Zenith, Aurelia, and Vanguard. Survive the lawless frontier.
campaign_story_summary: The sector is divided into three spheres of influence. Zenith demands strict compliance with trade routes. Aurelia seeks to expand their mining claims. Vanguard enforces a hardline stance on border security. You are an independent pilot seeking profit. A shortage of refined minerals has sparked a local conflict. You must navigate the friction between these powers.

opening.status_quo: The sector is divided among three corporate entities.
opening.visible_crisis: Refined mineral shortages are causing supply chain disruptions.
opening.hidden_crisis: A secret trade agreement between Zenith and Aurelia is failing.
opening.why_now: The collapse of the deal makes current routes dangerous.
opening.player_role: An independent pilot with a debt-ridden ship.

mystery.question: Why are the mineral prices fluctuating so wildly?
mystery.false_answer: A pirate group is sabotaging the supply lines.
mystery.true_answer_hint: The minerals are being diverted to an off-world project.
mystery.long_term_reveal_direction: The diversion reveals a secret infrastructure project.

kaelen.secret_angle: She knows the true destination of the diverted minerals.
kaelen.address_rule: Refer to her as a broker or fixer.
kaelen.never_reveal_rule: Never reveal her role in the shadow government.

factions.conflict_triangle: The three factions are fighting over the overlap of mining claims.
factions.neutral_space_pressure: Pirates and scavengers populate the lawless zones.

act_1.name: The Broker's Contract
act_1.goal: Secure a stable supply route for Aurelia.
act_1.opening_incident: A shipment of refined minerals is intercepted by Vanguard patrols.
act_1.midpoint_turn: You discover that the cargo was meant for Zenith territory.
act_1.finale: You successfully deliver the cargo to an Aurelia outpost.
act_1.player_takeaway: The player learns that logistics are a weapon.

starter_mission.title: Clear the Path
starter_mission.reason: A pirate ship is blocking a primary trade route.
starter_mission.enemy_knows: The Reaver is patrolling its assigned sector.
starter_mission.after_effect: You earn your first payment and local reputation.

recurring_clue.name: Marked Cargo
recurring_clue.signal: A recurring pattern of marked crates in non-standard ports.
recurring_clue.first_appearance: The player finds a crate with an Aurelia logo.
recurring_clue.escalation: More shipments appear in locations that are restricted zones.
recurring_clue.payoff_hint: These crates contain high-grade components for specialized construction.

rumor_trail.name: The Ghost Route
clue_templates: A smuggler claims a route exists outside of official records.
A merchant says the cargo is moving in the opposite direction.
rumor_trail.payoff: Unlock a hidden passage to a nearby mining colony.

horizon.gate_tease: A gate is rumored to be unstable and leads to unknown territory.
horizon.new_system_reveal_rule: Introduce new systems based on the player's choice of faction support.
horizon.future__pressure_tease: Rumors of a growing pirate presence in the outer rim.
horizon.future_ore_or_upgrade_tease: A rare ore type is found only in the system's edge.

regeneration_trigger.description: When a major arc is completed, add a new contract for the next system.

rules.humor_rule: Use dry humor. Avoid jokes about space-time.
rules.fallback: If no contract is available, offer a delivery mission.
